aliasNote: The source registry key is `gemini` with no alias. The local gemini registry `alias` is also `gemini`. `gemini-cli`, `gemini-web`, `gemini-interactions`, `vertex`/`vx` are different providers and must not dispatch here.

connectionModes.api_key: credentials.apiKey (trimmed) sent as `x-goog-api-key`; wins when an access token is also present (source precedence)
connectionModes.oauth: credentials.accessToken sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; existing gemini OAuth connections keep their token refresh path

request.wireBody: { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: <trimmed prompt> }] }] } (no generationConfig)

response.shape: { object: 'music.generation', created, provider: 'gemini', model, status: 'completed', data: [{ b64_json, format, mime_type, duration_seconds? }] }
response.resultContract: musicGenerationCore: { success, outcome, connectionId, accounting, response } | createErrorResult(...) + { outcome, connectionId, acceptedJob? }

publicHandlerIntegration.change: dispatch provider 'gemini' (isGeminiMusicProvider) to handleGeminiMusicGeneration({ model, body, credentials, signal }) before the MUSIC_ADAPTERS cookie lookup; reject requestId (synchronous, nothing to poll)
none beyond the existing acceptedJob branch: it already records recordAcceptedJobUsage and refuses fallback after an accepted job
add 'music' service kind, the three Lyria models with kind 'music', and musicConfig { baseUrl, authType: 'apikey', authHeader: 'x-goog-api-key', format: 'gemini-lyria' }
classify `lyria-*` models that list generateContent as music (not chat), using parseGeminiMusicModels

discovery: discoverGeminiMusicModels({ credentials, signal }) pages models.list for the selected connection and keeps `lyria-*` ids that list generateContent; listGeminiMusicModels() returns the pinned static list
